system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: MCD19A2.061: Terra & Aqua MAIAC Land Aerosol Optical Depth Daily 1km

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global 1 km gridded land coverage; valid retrievals are limited by observation geometry, clouds, surface conditions and MAIAC quality masks.

analytical_capabilities: Map the spatial distribution and regional gradients of land aerosol optical depth
Analyze daily, seasonal and interannual variability in aerosol loading
Compare the 0.47 micrometre and 0.55 micrometre AOD retrievals
Use uncertainty and quality fields to screen and characterize retrieval reliability
Aggregate daily granules to regular grids or time windows for regional analysis

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Land aerosol optical depth at 0.47 micrometres (Optical_Depth_047) and 0.55 micrometres (Optical_Depth_055), dimensionless.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the catalog band names Optical_Depth_047 and Optical_Depth_055 with scale 0.001; AOD_Uncertainty uses scale 0.0001. AOD_QA is a 16-bit bitmask: bits 0-2 cloud mask, bits 3-4 land/water/snow/ice mask, bits 5-7 adjacency mask, bits 8-11 AOD QA, bit 12 glint mask, bits 13-14 aerosol model, and bit 15 reserved. Catalog ranges are -100 to 8000 for both AOD bands and 0 to 30000 for AOD_Uncertainty; no separate fill value is specified in the catalog metadata. Apply the documented scales and QA masks before analysis.

data_description.data_source: NASA LP DAAC at the USGS EROS Center, hosted by Google Earth Engine
